TestGorilla sources candidates for your role and tells you why each one made the shortlist. Meant for small teams, agencies and companies who want to find great talent, and proof they can do the job. Backed up with skills assessments, so every interview is worth its time.
See how we source
Our technology
Anyone can hand you twenty names.
We can tell you why these twenty.
Ranking is a measurement problem, so we treat it like one. Hard facts like location, seniority, degree, and employer are matched deterministically by our AI on rules, never inferred. Everything else is retrieved semantically, on meaning rather than keyword overlap.
The next AI model then reads each profile against each requirement you wrote. It returns the evidence behind the match: what it found, where it found it, and where it found nothing at all. The ranking is built from that evidence.
unlocks

power
Not your average AI, the he only proof-first AI Recruiting platform. Backed by decades of I-O psychology expertise and skills-based hiring data, we’ve built features that cut through the noise.
Start with the role, and let AI turn your brief into a smart search. AI searches 900M+ global profiles, including our unique pool of 3M+ skills-tested candidates. It then ranks the strongest matches against what matters for your role. Fully explainable.
Explore now
Next, let our AI suggest the ideal evaluation mix for your role: the right skills tests, custom questions, and AI interviews. Every recommendation is backed by guardrails set and tested by our science specialists, giving you total confidence in your evaluation.
See the library
From essays to video responses, our AI scores open-ended answers quickly and consistently, with scoring criteria reviewed by our team of I-O psychologists.
For custom questions created by you, use our AI to quickly generate scoring criteria of your own. You review, adjust if needed, and decide who moves forward.
With 100s of applications now the norm, your longlist keeps growing. Video can help. Our AI interviews and video questions ask every candidate the same questions and score them against the same rubric. You know who can actually do the job before you book a single call.
Know more
Our
Resume scoring
feature uses a biodata framework, evaluating what candidates have
actually done
rather than the titles they’ve held. We score resumes using structured, evidence-based criteria like knowledge, skills, and leadership behaviors.
The result? Meaningful career and skills signals tailored to your job description. Use these insights to spot top-fit candidates and move them to the next stage with confidence.
Our AI manifesto
Human-in-the-loop by design
Our AI never makes decisions for you. Every suggestion is fully editable, reviewable, and optional.
Focused on fairness
Our AI scoring is benchmarked against expert ratings and continually monitored to keep results fair.
Always transparent
We clearly disclose AI functionality to customers and candidates – no black boxes or hidden logic.
Private by default
We never train our AI on customer data, and no personal data is sent to or used by LLMs.
Tools, not gimmicks
Our AI solves real hiring challenges, like scoring open-ended answers and validating skills, so you can hire faster and smarter.
Designed for evolving standards
We monitor emerging AI regulations and continuously improve our safeguards to meet new expectations.
Our framework for AI fluency
Use TestGorilla to assess for the 5 components of AI-fluency – based on a framework designed by our experts.
Applied AI use
When and where does AI work, and what are its technical limitations. Choose from MCQ-based AI-skills assessments to identify the right candidates.
See tests
Learning and digital ability
Learning new AI workflows quickly and adapting when tools or constraints change (positively or limitations) to translate emerging technology into productivity gains.
Try an AI interview
Systems thinking & problem solving
AI-fluent talent can frame ambiguous problems, deconstruct into tasks, and reason about how AI decisions ripple across systems. Measured by the right skills test.
See test
Responsible and ethical AI use
AI-fluent professionals recognize bias, privacy, and governance challenges, documenting decisions and building safeguards. Because "moving fast" must still mean "moving responsibly".
Book a demo
Human-AI collaboration and communication
Our AI interviews can identify AI-fluent talent that can communicate assumptions, prompts, and outputs clearly, knowing trade-offs, and maintaining transparency in shared workflows.
See AI interviews
You
ask.
answer.
We don’t believe AI should or will ever replace humans in hiring. It’s a tool to support better decisions, not make them for you. Used responsibly and paired with human judgment, AI can make hiring faster, fairer, and smarter by surfacing job-relevant data and skills-based insights.
We see AI as a shared responsibility. That’s why our features are made to be fairness-first: benchmarked against expert human scorers, tested for bias and adverse impact, and continuously updated with the latest research and ethical best practices. And always with humans in the loop.
No. Personal data (PII), whether from customers, candidates, or job seekers, is never shared with generative AI models (LLMs), and suppliers of these models are contractually prohibited from training on the data we do share. Our Natural Language Processing (NLP) models are trained in-house. These models are used to score candidate answers without bias. To accomplish this, they are trained on both candidate answers and demographic characteristics of candidates. Because we train these models in-house, none of the training data is shared externally.
Yes. All of our AI features operate with a human-in-the-loop approach. That means AI only makes suggestions – you’re free to ignore, adjust, or reject them. The system never acts autonomously.
We follow strict data privacy and ethical design standards, including GDPR, SOC2, and EEOC-aligned practices. We’re actively preparing for evolving frameworks like the EU AI Act and continuously update our safeguards to stay ahead of regulatory developments.
Beyond new AI regulations, existing non-discrimination laws also apply to AI use. Customers should ensure their hiring practices comply with these laws and that new technologies are not used in ways that discriminate.
We are committed to ethical responsibility in everything we build.
In our
AI job builder,
recommendations are anchored to expert-reviewed, job-relevant criteria – never demographic or proxy signals – and all recommended tests must meet our quality and validity standards.
For
resume scoring,
we proactively remove personal information such as names and pronouns, run experiments to identify and eliminate choices that may introduce bias, and integrate ongoing fairness checks into our psychometric monitoring.
All our
scoring tools
are regularly tested for adverse impact and benchmarked against human reviewers, and all outputs are transparent and editable.
AI interview scoring
is always based on transcripts, never facial cues or emotional expression, and we are fully transparent about what’s measured.
No AI is bias-free, but it beats humans on consistency and fairness – delivering
up to 45% fairer treatment
for women and minority candidates according to studies.
We see AI as a valuable opportunity to raise hiring standards, and we’re committed to doing so through continuous monitoring, ongoing improvements, and the application of the latest research and best practices.
No. AI helps scale and standardize scoring, but humans remain in charge. Every score can be reviewed, edited, or overridden by recruiters, and we encourage human review at every stage.
In our vision of fair, human-led hiring,
AI interviews
give every candidate a fair shot from the start. Rather than relying on manual resume review—which can overlook strong talent and use up recruiter time—our AI interviews help you standardize and scale the screening process, reducing the risk of missed matches.
They’re tailored to each role and scored only on transcripts – not facial expressions or appearance – so candidates are judged on what they say, not how they look or sound.
For candidates, this means a level playing field and the flexibility to interview on their own terms. For hiring teams, it means consistent insights, a more diverse talent pool, and hidden talent brought to light, all while staying firmly in control of final decisions.
Yes. Transparency matters. We let candidates know whenever AI is part of the process, and we safeguard their data at every step.
